final_text:
CAUSE: `/api/sessions/{name}/send` treats a dashboard operator as authenticated only when `validate_session()` accepts the session cookie. With both dashboard credentials empty, `app/auth.py:is_auth_enabled()` says authorization is off, but `validate_session()` returns `False` whenever either credential is empty. The frontend sends `{message, scope}` with no `sender` or session cookie, so `app/routes/sessions.py:send_message` rejects the request with `SOURCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED`.

Recommended fix: in `send_message`, recognize an unauthenticated dashboard operator when `is_auth_enabled()` is false, while preserving sender and valid-session checks when authorization is enabled. This aligns chat provenance with the configured no-auth mode.
